title: Large text/bytea argument in and out (identity function)

variants.name: text_1MB
variants.query: SELECT sum(length({fn}(t))) FROM (SELECT t || '' AS t FROM bench_blob, generate_series(1, {reps})) s

variants.name: bytea_1MB
variants.query: SELECT sum(length({fn}(b))) FROM (SELECT b || ''::bytea AS b FROM bench_blob, generate_series(1, {reps})) s
